# iosxr_password6 (Data Source)

This data source can read the Password6 configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxr_password6" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `encryption_aes` (Boolean) Configure a key type aes
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
